chunks: And ʿImrān al-Ḥalabī narrated from him that he said:
"It is appropriate to lighten the salat (prayer) because of forgetfulness."

key_terms.الْحَلَبِيُّ: al-Ḥalabī; the attribution of the narrator
key_terms.رَوَى: narrated; indicates transmission of the hadith
key_terms.عِمْرَانُ: ʿImrān; the narrator named in the chain

ai.seo_question: Why should the salat (prayer) be lightened because of forgetfulness?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates that the salat (prayer) should be lightened on account of forgetfulness or the possibility of inattention. It reflects a practical legal and devotional teaching concerning the manner of performing prayer with consideration for human limitation.
